text: The Horror Clutch can be found along the northern fork of the Horrid March in the shadow of Kypari Vor in northern Dread Wastes. Qi'tar the Deathcaller, a fallen paragon, can be found inside the clutch.
Horrorjaw is the biggest and most dangerous crocolisk found in the Wetlands. James Halloran wants his hide so that he could buy a new house for his family to dwell in.
Howling Spirits are mogu ghosts located in the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

Hozen Bouncers are hozen in the downstairs of the Stormstout Brewhall in the Stormstout Brewery. They prevent players from going on the next stage without defeating the boss. After Ook-Ook is defeated, the adventurer becomes the new "Ook" and then will dance on the "stage" with spotlights shining around.
Howah Deeptan is a tauren leatherworking vendor located at the Cenarion Wildlands in Desolace.

Hozen-Fur Fuse drops rarely while using Kota Kon to kill Burlap Trail hozen for the daily quest The Burlap Grind (daily) in Kun-Lai Summit. It will take some time (far more than the 100 kills the daily quest requires).

How Did He Get Up There? is an achievement earned for finding a way to get the Hozen Clinger to let go in Stormstout Brewery on any difficulty.

The Howling Crag is an area in Spires of Arak, west of the Pillars of Fate.

.]] House Blackwood is the former ruling noble house of the town of Blackwood. After Baron Blackwood fell, the land was ruled by Baron Garithos instead. Now the Forsaken have raised back Baron Blackwood in order to legitimize their claim to the area.
How It's Made: Arcwine is a quest in Suramar given by Margaux.
Hot Swapper is an achievement earned by achieving 250,000 points while using the JewelCraft toy.
Horux is a felstalker located in Felbeast Dens in Azsuna on the Broken Isles.
Houndmaster Stroxis is a felguard located in Faronaar in Azsuna.
__NOTOC__ Hovel Shadowcasters are ogre mages in Gar'gol's Hovel in Mount Hyjal.
__NOTOC__ Hovel Brutes are ogres located in Gar'gol's Hovel in Mount Hyjal.
Hounds are a category of dog-like canines. Whereas "dogs" consist of small domesticated breeds, "hounds" include various larger and more monstrous dog relatives.
Houndmasters are eredar located in the Arcatraz during Foiling the Legion's Jailbreak.
Hot Papaya Milk is sold by Grimthorn Redbeard on the Timeless Isle for .

House Waycrest is one of four noble houses that rule Kul Tiras. Their seat is the Waycrest Manor, in the region of Drustvar. Before their establishment as a House, the Waycrest family led the war against the Drust when humans first settled Kul Tiras thousands of years ago. Providing most of the nation's ore and some of its toughest warriors, House Waycrest has been a loyal supporter of House Proudmoore's rule for centuries.

House Stormsong is one of the four noble houses that rule Kul Tiras. Their seat is the Shrine of the Storm, in the region of Stormsong Valley. It takes a role in the construction of the country's navy. The Tidesages serve House Stormsong. Tideguard Victoria and Legends of the Tidesages give alternate dates for the settlement of Kul Tiras and of Stormsong Valley.
__NOTOC__ Horrified Drakkari Shaman are ice trolls running from Drak'Tharon Keep in Zul'Drak to Grizzly Hills.
__NOTOC__ Horrified Drakkari Warriors are ice trolls running from Drak'Tharon Keep in Zul'Drak to Grizzly Hills.
Hot Couture is about collecting a full set of Firelands armor for one class.

House Ashvane is one of the four ruling houses of Kul Tiras. They also control the Ashvane Trading Company. It is unknown where House Ashvane's main residence is. Their holdings include the Ashvane Company Yards and Ashvane Docks in Boralus, as well as the town of Bridgeport and the Ashvane Foundry.

The House of the Lost Loa is located at the Terrace of the Chosen in Zuldazar. It has stelae for the loa Quetz'lun, Akali, Mam'toth, Hakkar, Rhunok, Sseratus and Tharon'ja. Through the course of the Zandalar storyline, new stelae are added for Rezan, Shadra and Hir'eek.
The Horseback Courier is a human located in Fizzsprings Resort in Tiragarde Sound. She is escorting a Courier Pack Mule.
Hotshot is a horse located in Foxhollow Woods in Tiragarde Sound.

Hour of Reckoning begins the Alliance perspective of the Battle for Lordaeron, part of the Battle for Azeroth intro experience. Players will be offered this quest after completing the War of the Thorns storyline, ending with From the Ashes....
The Hour of Twilight trailer is the official trailer for Hour of Twilight Patch 4.3.
Hound-Jowl Waistband drops from the Soulbound Goliath in Waycrest Manor.
The House of Pa'ku is located in the Terrace of the Chosen in Dazar'alor.

The House of Fallen Tribes is a dwelling located under the building in front of the Darkspear Embassy, in the Terrace of the Speakers. It houses Speaker Ik'nal of the Shadowtooth Clan and Speaker Malaka'raz of the Drakkari tribe, both the last representatives of their tribes.
How to Make Money and Influence Subordinates is looted from Alliance Bounties and Horde Bounties.
How to Ptrain Your Pterrordax is a quest achievement earned for completing the quest series to earn the Kua'fon's Harness mount.
Howling Voodoo Masks are enchanted tikis located in Zuldazar.
__NOTOC__ Houndmaster Leopold is a worgen located in Mangrove Shore in Nazmir.
__NOTOC__ Houndmaster Britomar is a nightborne noble who was planned to lead the hunt for Volpin. Class order champions defeated him and stole his map showing where the event would take place.
Horrific Shriekers are n'raqi located in the Eternal Palace.
Horrific Summoners are n'raqi located in the Eternal Palace.
Horrific Visions are fleshbeasts located in the Eternal Palace.

A howdah is a seat or box, usually with a canopy and railing, placed on the back of a Huge or larger creature, such as a kodo beast or elephant. Four medium riders can fit on a howdah. Many creatures, especially orcs and tauren, build ornate and elaborate howdahs as symbols of prestige, or open-aired and spiked howdahs for military applications. In addition to being well out of infantry's range, howdahs grant their occupants cover. It weights 100 lbs.
Houndlord Ren is a mogu located in Autumnshade Ridge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. He only spawns during Assault: The Warring Clans.

Hounds Good To Me is a dungeons & raids achievement earned by defeating the Felhounds of Sargeras in Antorus, the Burning Throne on Normal difficulty or higher with both Felhounds afflicted with 5 stacks of Fel Imbuement.
Horrific Vision of Stormwind is an expansion feature achievement earned by defeating Alleria in the Horrific Vision of Stormwind.
Horrific Vision of Orgrimmar is an expansion feature achievement earned by defeating Thrall in the Horrific Vision of Orgrimmar.
__NOTOC__ Hovok is a kunchong located in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Howling Winds are unbound air elementals located in Skywall.
Hozen Beercatchers are hozen located in the Valley of the Four Winds.

Hozen Cages are cages located in the Slingtail Pits in the Jade Forest. They are used by the Slingtail hozens to contain the Alliance Prisoners and Jinyu Prisoners which can be unlocked with a Bamboo Key as part of the Freeing Our Brothers.
__NOTOC__ Horrormaster Damnik is a venthyr stable master located at Wanecrypt Hill in Revendreth.
Host Ta'rela is a broker innkeeper located in the Idyllia in Oribos.
Hour of Reaping is an Azerite trait available to Vengeance demon hunters.

A House Grinchin Ring can be found inside a Grinchin Calligraphy Set in a house in the Chalice District in Revendreth. It's used to make the Treasure Guardian give you access to House Grinchin's Secret Treasure.
The Horror Novel is looted from Dusty Books in the Ember Ward in Revendreth. The book can be handed in to Lord Scowl in return for access to the Secret Treasure.

How to School Your Serpent teaches hunters how to tame cloud serpents. This item is a reputation reward; you must be with Order of the Cloud Serpent to purchase this item from San Redscale in the Arboretum in the Jade Forest for . Although only characters with the necessary reputation can purchase and use this item, it can be used by any class and unlocks the skill account-wide.

The House of Eyes is one of the five houses that rule Maldraxxus, whose members are called the Eyes. Filled with those who fought, lived, and died by their wits and cunning, it was a tenacious and cunning force in Maldraxxus. As befit its name, it was the intelligence arm of Maldraxxus, gathering intel in the worlds of the living and the dead. The Eyes have developed ways to extract information without words, extracting the memory directly from their mind. Some members are expert marksmen assassins. While regrowing, they've established a method for spying on the other realms, using eyes placed at the House of Rituals, the Eonian Archives, Tirna Vaal and Castle Nathria. Every House of Maldrax

The House of Constructs is one of the five houses that rule Maldraxxus. The purpose of this House is the creation of necrotic constructs -- abominations and their ilk, to populate Maldraxxus's armies. However, as of late, Margrave Gharmal has been serving a very different master. It is the origin of all the abomination constructs of the necrolords and their fleshcrafters, who depend on the art of fleshcrafting embued within their Margrave and used by the Primus in creating Maldraxxus. The house is not just abominations. Liches are present, such as Faldo Iscar in the Amputory, as well as aranakk in the Thread House, such as Thread Mistress Leeda. The House of the Chosen is one of the five houses that rule Maldraxxus. Filled with countless champions, this house is one of the last holdouts against the Jailer's insidious campaign. Every House of Maldraxxus has two Barons. Initially, Vyraz and Alexandros Mograine served as the two barons, though the latter was later captured and imprisoned in the Maw; assumed dead. He was replaced by Draka, who came into the service of the House shortly after the fall of the House of Eyes. Mograine returned with the aid of the Maw Walker, though he did not resume his position. House Thornhill is one of the noble venthyr houses of Revendreth. Given this house's manor belonged to Duke Theotar, having later been replaced by Viscount Nicolae, he was presumably the head of this house.

Howling Shades are shades located in Korthia and the Maw. They can be summoned by Mawsworn Shadetwisters and Mawsworn Stonetwisters.

How to Train a Dragonkin is a reward from Taming the Dragon...kin, which becomes available at Renown level 23 with the Valdrakken Accord. This item teaches hunters how to tame lesser dragonkin, as well as vorquin (which belong to the stag family instead). It can only be learned on a hunter character.
Hot Research Zone is an exploration achievement earned by killing 500 hostile creatures during either of the Researchers Under Fire events.
How to train your Dryad is a tome found on a bench in the Shady Sanctuary in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Howling Riftdwellers are unbound air elementals located at Lightning Ledge in Mount Hyjal.

The House Malem is a noble Darnassian merchant family. The father of the house is unknown and doesn't appear in World of Warcraft, however, his son and daughter do. When his children went missing the father, fearing the worst, sent Vahlarriel Demonslayer in search of them.

:This article is about the human lore. For the playable races, see Human (playable), and Kul Tiran (playable). Humans (also collectively referred to as mankind or humanity) are a resilient species native to the world of Azeroth. Recent discoveries have shown that humans are descended from the barbaric half-giant vrykul of Northrend. Born "weak" and "deformed" as a result of the Curse of Flesh, they had to be exterminated to keep the vrykul race pure, but not all vrykul could bear to kill their children, and they took them away to a land far away from Northrend, in the northern Eastern Kingdoms. Low level characters trying to kill (rather than tame) him should pull him away from the other lions under the tree, as he emits a "Thundering Roar" when low on health that will aggro all nearby lions, often resulting in a swift death for the careless.

Hula'mahi is a jungle troll reagents, herbs, and poison vendor located at the Crossroads in the Northern Barrens. He was rescued by an adventurer during the Legion invasions.

Hungarfen is a large fungal giant, and one of the leaders of them. He can be found as the first boss of The Underbog in Coilfang Reservoir. He has been tending a very special plant, known as the Underspore, to perfection for millennia.
__NOTOC__ Hukku was an undead troll warlock once found in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar. Hukku was accompanied by his imp, succubus, and voidwalker.

Hulking Helboars are helboars found in the Hellfire Peninsula. At roughly 50% health, they enrage with an emote, "Hulking Helboar begins to grow stronger." Their size enlarges and their damage increases.
__NOTOC__ The Huge Spotted Feltail is Held In Off-hand, but has no stats.
__NOTOC__ Hungarhide Gauntlets drop from Hungarfen in the Underbog.
Huffer is a boar companion of Rexxar. He is summoned by his whistle. When Rexxar takes him to Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff, he usually receives special jerky from Hesuwa Thunderhorn.
Huge Stone Club drops from Bloodscalp Berserkers in Northern Stranglethorn.
Humbert's Pants drop from dwarves in Dun Garok in the Hillsbrad Foothills.
The Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper drops from Ras Frostwhisper in Scholomance after using Soulbound Keepsake on him.
Huffer's Whistle is provided as an objective for A Boaring Time for Grulloc.
Human Bone Chip is a racial PvP token used for the quest Human Bone Chip (quest) in order to receive a Dented Ashmaul Strongbox.

Human cannons, also known as Alliance cannons and, in the model files, human tanks, are siege weapons used by Honor Hold to fight Thrallmar, and the Fel Horde of Hellfire Citadel. They can be seen on the opposite side of the Path of Glory from the Horde's blade throwers, and in the wreckage in front of the Black Temple. Human cannons look like human towers, but with a large cannon in front, and a long exhaust pipe in back, set on top of tank treads. They were likely created by the Alliance Expedition after the Dark Portal was closed. Members of the Horde are tasked with burning them in Burn It Up... For the Horde!. Hulg was a forest troll belonging to Gree's tribe. He helped capture Vereesa Windrunner and Falstad Dragonreaver, but died in a battle against hill dwarves — the rescuers of Vereesa and Falstad.

The Human Expedition (referred to as the survivors of Lordaeron or the Alliance refugees) was an expedition and a league of Alliance military and civilian groups that fled to Kalimdor from Lordaeron after the plague of undeath and the Scourge decimated the kingdoms of Lordaeron, Quel'Thalas, and Dalaran. They were led by Jaina Proudmoore, who was determined to find a safe haven for her people, she being the only human who listened to the Prophet Medivh and fled. While called the "Human Expedition", the military forces had high elven survivors from Quel'Thalas, dwarves of Khaz Modan and Aerie Peak, gnomes, and members of the 7th Legion. Hruon Firesinger is a tauren, and a shaman in his tribe. He once stood on a hill and looked east over the lands of Mulgore. He knew that Mulgore represented hope for the tauren people. It would make a good home where they could practice their traditions freely. He also knew it would be a good place to defend against the centaur.
Huge Snowballs are contained in Lord Ahune's Ice Chest. It is much larger than a regular Snowball.
__NOTOC__ Hungering Cold is a Death knight talent found on Tier 5 of the Frost tree. It allows the death knight to freeze all enemies within 10 yards for up to 10 seconds.
Hozzer is a polar bear usually encountered during the quest The Jig is Up, wherein he devours Jonah Sterling, spyglass and all. You then have to kill Hozzer to get the spyglass back.

Hulking Jormungar are jormungar located in the Dragon Wastes in Dragonblight. They can also be seen in Hour of Twilight.
Hungering Dead are skeletons and ghouls located in Dawn's Reach in the Dragonblight.

Humbert's Chestpiece dropped from dwarves in Dun Garok in Hillsbrad Foothills prior to Cataclysm.

Players must escort him from the burning lab to her, using the to spray him and the cart occasionally in order to prevent the Azsharite from exploding. When sprayed, the Hulking Labgoblin will make remarks of a vaguely sexual nature.

Hugo Lentner is a worgen engineering supplies vendor located in the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus. He's most likely related to fellow engineering trainer Tana Lentner. During the Burning of Teldrassil, he was caught in the chaos and could be saved.

Hozen Traders are hozen traveling through the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair to have some relaxation in the tavern's bathtub.

Hozen in the Mist is an exploration achievement earned by discovering the hozen lore objects. The four hozen idols and their locations are: *Hozen Speech Fertile Copse, Jade Forest *Hozen Maturity in the cave on east end of Unga Ingoo, Krasarang Wilds *Embracing the Passions west side of the building at Pang's Stead, Valley of the Four Winds *The Hozen Ravage North of the Dooker Dome in Kun-Lai Summit Upon interaction with the fourth lore object, adventurers will immediately gain 2000 reputation with the Lorewalkers, and sends a letter via the in-game mail system: Attached is Hozen in the Mist (item), which begins a quest, Hozen in the Mist (quest).

Hozen Speech is a hozen lore object found at in the Fertile Copse between the Strongarm Airstrip and Camp Nooka Nooka in northwest Jade Forest. Interacting with the lore object is one of the objectives of the Pandaria exploration achievement Hozen in the Mist.
Huge Panther Fang can be found on the corpses of s in Zhu Province of Krasarang Wilds.

Hugh can be found in the Caverns of Time instance, Escape from Durnholde Keep. He is standing in a group of kids east side of Southshore. It's unknown what became of him.
Hugen Goldwise is an archaeology trainer located on the top floor of the inn at the Alliance outpost of Valgarde in Howling Fjord.

During the Fourth War, Huelo was impaled by a spear during a Kul Tiran attack on Seawatch Point in Stormsong Valley. The adventurer finds him laying on the ground, and Huelo is killed by Rexxar as an act of mercy due to the severity of the wound.
